purpose: Registration fragment for the Airlock Plan application: the owner binding of Universal UserIO (userio_owner) plus the agentsdk 0.8 migration that made the app buildable again. Merges into integrations/airlock-apps/apps.json; the registry itself is read-only for this task.

principal.note: The binding reuses the owner's own Universal UserIO resource; no per-user member credential exists for it (agent_mcp_member_credentials holds 0 rows platform-wide).

platform_rule.text: binding.user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN need.binding_mode='shared' THEN NULL ELSE $1::uuid END AND (m.owner_principal_id = creator.id OR EXISTS (resource_grants with 'use' for creator))
platform_rule.consequence: A shared MCP resource resolves only while its owner_principal_id equals the binding creator (binding.created_by_user_id), or the creator holds a 'use' grant.
platform_rule.verified_by: read-only SELECT: resource 365c1a4b owner_principal_id=5e438326 and both bindings (airlockplan c2abb3bf, universal-userio 54968a2c) created_by_user_id=5e438326 -> the rule holds for both.

mcp_resource.name: Universal UserIO
mcp_resource.shared_with: the same resource backs the universal-userio app binding userio_owner (54968a2c); re-keying it rotates the owner-side credential for both, exactly the step the universal-userio-oleg fragment prescribes for the owner side

defects_found_and_fixed.symptom: build a22062e6 (2026-10-23 11:00 UTC) failed with 'air: unknown command "stage-runtime-files"'
defects_found_and_fixed.cause: the app go.mod pinned github.com/airlockrun/agentsdk v0.7.0, so 'go tool air' resolved to the 0.7.0 air, while the platform builder image ships agentsdk 0.8.1-alpha.12 whose scaffold Dockerfile calls 'go tool air stage-runtime-files'
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: integrations/airlock-apps/go.mod: agentsdk v0.7.0 -> v0.8.1-alpha.12, go 1.26.6 -> 1.26.9 (scaffold.GoVersion of the builder image), go.sum regenerated by go mod tidy

defects_found_and_fixed.symptom: with the SDK bumped, build 52a1f171 failed in the manifest inspection: 'panic: agentsdk: RegisterMCP("airlockplan"): BindingMode is required'
defects_found_and_fixed.cause: agentsdk 0.8 requires BindingMode on an authenticated MCP registration; the app did not pass it
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: integrations/airlock-apps/main.go: the binding struct gained an optional binding_mode field and RegisterMCP now passes BindingMode (manifest value, default shared, which matches the platform need spec binding_mode=shared)

defects_found_and_fixed.symptom: go mod tidy failed against agentsdk 0.8: 'package github.com/airlockrun/agentsdk/agenttest provided by ... at latest version v0.7.0 but not at required version v0.8.1-alpha.12'
defects_found_and_fixed.cause: SDK 0.8 removed the agentsdk/agenttest local-host harness (see /libs/agentsdk/UPGRADING.md, v0.8.1-alpha.12); the app tests imported it
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: main_test.go and ui_proxy_test.go migrated to the SDK 0.8 offline fixtures (agentsdk/testutil.WithCaller with a validated wire.Caller). Tests that needed the removed local host now assert the guard and delegation behaviour that is reachable offline; the MCP proxy round-trip and the runtime-backed parts of the UI proxy need a real Airlock runner and are not covered by the unit tests any more.

defects_found_and_fixed.symptom: the first call through the new binding returned 'MCP HTTP 401 Unauthorized' from https://msg.bezrabotnyi.com/mcp
defects_found_and_fixed.cause: the credential stored on the shared resource was stale; the owner's token in /tmp/userio_owner_token is accepted by the upstream (initialize returns HTTP 200, serverInfo universal-userio 0.2.0; without the bearer it returns 401)
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: POST /api/v1/agents/4bbb8bd0-e5ee-43be-babb-48e763d6eafb/mcp-servers/userio_owner/credentials with the owner's UserIO bearer (value never stored in this fragment)

apply.status: applied 2026-10-23 13:19-13:49 UTC; the need only exists after a successful build, so the bind had to follow the upload

verify.check: platform sees both bindings and their tools
verify.expected: airlockplan: 17 airlock_* tools; userio_owner: 61 userio.* tools

verify.check: live read-only call through the agent token
verify.observed_2026_10_23: HTTP 200 isError=false {"ok":true,"chats":[{"id":"conv_f9505f1de653de31f6a1e3b2","channel":"telegram","title":"MariM","unread":1}]} (the response also carries a message snippet; it is not reproduced here)

verify.check: the sibling app that shares the UserIO resource is unaffected

notes: The app container is idle-reaped by the platform ('stopping idle container' in the backend log). It is reconciled again on the next admitted request or with POST /api/v1/agents/{id}/start; the agent token lives in the container environment, so a probe that needs the token must start the container first.

The app's own operation allowlist (apps.json operations) still lists only the airlock_* operations; the platform-level userio_owner binding is independent of that list. Exposing userio.* through the app's own service_read tool would need an apps.json change, which was out of scope here.
The go.mod/go.sum/test migration lives in the shared integrations/airlock-apps source, so every app uploaded from it inherits the SDK 0.8 pin; re-uploads of the other apps pick it up.
